payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the image’s content read as a drawing rather than a photograph with blur, grain, or texture overlaid?
node.criteria: pass: evidence identifies drawn or illustrated rendering replacing photographic detail across the image’s content, including prominent subjects and surrounding areas; fail: evidence identifies retained photographic rendering with only blur, grain, or texture overlays; unknown: visible cues do not reliably distinguish drawing conversion from filtered photography. State the specific cues supporting the judgment and note any substantial photographic areas.
node.binding: Assess drawing-form conversion and its extent across the image. Do not assess chalk medium; do not treat sketch-like outlines, blur, or texture alone as proof of conversion.
